predictions.articleTitle: Al-Duhail SC vs Qatar SC Prediction & Match Analysis: Unbeaten Attack vs Fragile Backline
predictions.coreRecommendation: Al-Duhail SC are projected to secure a full-time Home Win in an Over 2.5 and BTTS Yes contest built on their 2.28 home goal expectancy against a 2.33 goals-conceded defense.
possibilityAssessment: Primary 1X2 Thesis: Home Win driven by Al-Duhail SC's 2.22 goals-per-game attack, five-match league winning streak, and Qatar SC's 2.33 goals-conceded rate (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)

Secondary Scoring Thesis: Over 2.5 goals and BTTS Yes supported by a 3.33 lambda_total, Al-Duhail conceding in four of their last five wins, and Qatar SC scoring twice in three recent away/neutral matches (Confidence: Moderate, Value: High)
Tactical Variance Angle: Al-Duhail's 56.5% big-chance waste rate keeps the half-time score competitive before second-half quality settles the margin (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)

btts.comment: Al-Duhail SC carry an 89.8% scoring projection and conceded in four of their last five wins, while Qatar SC retain a 65.0% scoring projection via João Pedro and Yohan Boli.

goals.comment: Three (22.0%) and four (18.3%) total goals flank the 3.33 lambda_total and map cleanly onto 2:1 and 3:1 Home Win scripts.
